nodes.description: Private mapping of account balances in ERC20; mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Private nested mapping of owner=>spender=>allowance; mutated by _approve.
Private total token supply; increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Private token name set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Private token symbol set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Private generator version string set in the GeneratorCopyright constructor.
Caller-controlled address used as owner/spender/mint recipient throughout the token.
_mint(_msgSender(), initialBalance_) in the SimpleERC20 constructor; unrestricted mint of the entire initial supply.
External call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) in the ServicePayer constructor; attacker-influenced receiver can reenter.
currentAllowance - amount arithmetic performed after the transfer in transferFrom.
senderBalance - amount and _balances[recipient] += amount arithmetic in _transfer.
_totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount arithmetic in _mint.
_balances[account] = accountBalance - amount and _totalSupply -= amount arithmetic in _burn.
_allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue arithmetic in increaseAllowance.
Public ERC20 transfer; delegates to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
Public ERC20 approve; delegates to _approve with _msgSender() as owner.
Public allowance-based transfer; performs _transfer then reduces the allowance.
Public helper that atomically increases an allowance via _approve.
Public helper that atomically decreases an allowance via _approve.
Internal balance-moving routine; validates addresses/balance and updates _balances.
Internal supply-creating routine; increases _totalSupply and recipient balance.
Internal supply-destroying routine; decreases holder balance and _totalSupply.
Internal routine writing the _allowances mapping after zero-address checks.
Empty virtual hook invoked before every transfer, mint and burn.
Payable constructor of SimpleERC20; validates initialBalance_ > 0, wires base contracts and mints the supply.
Payable constructor of ServicePayer; forwards msg.value to an external IPayable receiver.

edges.reason: _msgSender() returns the caller-controlled msg.sender address.
transfer passes _msgSender() into _transfer as the sender.
approve passes _msgSender() into _approve as the owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance bookkeeping.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
The initial supply is minted to the caller returned by _msgSender().
transfer delegates the balance change to _transfer.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
transferFrom moves tokens through _transfer.
transferFrom rewrites the allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance through _approve.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state changes.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before minting.
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before burning.
The constructor calls _mint to create the whole initial supply.
The constructor derives the mint recipient from _msgSender().
The SimpleERC20 constructor invokes the ServicePayer base constructor.
The ServicePayer constructor forwards msg.value into the external IPayable.pay call.
The external pay call occurs during construction and can reenter the mint/deployment flow.

transferFrom computes currentAllowance - amount on allowance state.
_transfer computes senderBalance - amount and increments the recipient balance.
_mint increments _totalSupply and the recipient balance.
_burn decrements the holder balance and _totalSupply.
increaseAllowance computes an allowance addition.

_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.

_burn decreases _totalSupply.
